newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse warns on merger information.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse warns on merger information.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) on Friday warned financial institutions to be more careful in disclosing information related to planned mergers.
The SET said in a statement that financial institutions must avoid disseminating incomplete information about their merger plans to the public or making disclosures during the trading session.
The bourse said it will halt or suspend trading in shares of any financial institutions which failed to meet the requirements.
The SET said it had amended and adjusted the rules about mergers of listed companies to be more flexible in supporting the government's policy of encouraging integration among financial institutions.
Where listed companies merge, the exchange said it would not require a fresh application for listing.
The Bank of Thailand on Thursday announced it will encourage more mergers among financial firms to strengthen the ailing sector by providing business incentives for those which agreed to merge.
